top_choice_rationale: B040 as a stand-alone prize to Katori and Ye is a distinct, mature, independently reproduced achievement: the magic-wavelength lattice cancels the trap light shift so many neutral atoms can be interrogated Doppler- and recoil-free, reaching 1e-18 and enabling redshift, constants and dark-matter tests. The credit split by contribution type (Katori scheme and first clock, Ye accuracy and many-body clock) is defensible, and I would not add a third name or an unrelated second part. P002 adds Hosono's secure, cleanly attributed discovery but has no common thread with the clock, so it ranks second; no award ranks last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the clock is atomic-physics precision measurement near my field but I have no direct collaboration with the candidates
